dan-sales: Heads-up 1 1 Enterprise security wants a compact access controls bundle for a POC reviewer. Must include: SSO/SAML attribute map (metadata + ACS), confirmation MFA is enforced for privileged users, SCIM provisioning docs showing group-scoped sync and delta sync example, RBAC samples demonstrating least-privilege (model-deployer, feature-ops, billing-admin), and one example of service-account key rotation + audit log snippet. Deadline: Thu EOD.

noor-sec: I can assemble the screenshots (Console > Integrations > SSO, Console > IAM > Roles) and a redacted audit slice. Will add the one-paragraph attestation from Security.

jamie-ops: For service accounts: we use HSM/KMS-backed secrets and short-lived tokens. Typical cadence: app tokens default TTL=30d; infra tokens default TTL=7d; key-rotator job runs daily and publishes rotation events to audit. I will export a redacted rotation event and the rotator Cron config.

megan-eng: SAML example (YAML we provide to customers):

megan-eng: ```yaml
name_id_format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
attributes:
  - name: email
    source: email
  - name: groups
    source: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group
  - name: entitlements
    source: http://schemas.openid.net/claims/entitlement
```

megan-eng: We'll include the metadata URL and ACS endpoint so their SAML admin can validate the entity.

noor-sec: MFA policy summary (one-paragraph): "Interactive SSO sessions require MFA for users in privileged groups (org-admin, billing-admin, model-deployer). MFA is enforced at the IdP and validated at session creation in Redwood. Non-privileged users have MFA recommended. Enforcement screenshots attached."

jamie-ops: SCIM notes: we support SCIM 2.0 and delta sync. Admins can restrict provisioning to mapped groups only and map multiple IdP groups to a single Redwood role. Example mapping in Console: IdP group "platform-engineers" -> Redwood role "model-deployer:execute".

megan-eng: SCIM delta PATCH example we commonly provide for tests: 

megan-eng: ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/{id} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-42"}]}]}'
```

jamie-ops: Also include the delta sync cursor example and the note that provisioning can be scoped by filtering expression (e.g., only groups matching ^eng- or specific group IDs).

noor-sec: RBAC evidence: we keep a roles CSV (role_id, role_name, surfaces, sample_permissions). For the bundle I'll attach a trimmed CSV with entries: org-admin, billing-admin, model-deployer, feature-ops, service-account. I'll flag elevated permissions and note separation-of-duties for org-admin vs billing-admin (billing endpoints gated behind billing-admin). Change to org-admin requires PR + two approvers (Security + Platform).

dan-sales: They usually want a signed attestation. Noor, can you include: date + contact + short statement that artifacts are accurate?

noor-sec: yes. Draft attestation: "Security attests that the attached SSO metadata, SCIM mappings, MFA policy screenshots, RBAC export, and redacted audit logs accurately reflect Redwood Inference access controls and provisioning behavior as of 2025-05-06. For verification contact security@redwood.example.com." I'll sign and include a PGP fingerprint option.

audit-bot: nightly audit export completed 04:05 UTC (audit-export/2025-05-05-0405.csv).

megan-eng: Plan: I'll collate SAML metadata + SCIM HOWTO, Jamie will supply rotation logs + Cron config, Noor will add screenshots + attestation, Dan will package and upload to the shared evidence path.

dan-sales: Upload location: https://redwood.app/shared/sales/poc-199/evidence. Please drop final pieces by Thu 23:59 UTC. I'll message the reviewer when uploaded.

noor-sec: Roger. Will ping here when files are in the folder. :white_check_mark:
